name: Razorflank's Medallion
summary: Charlga Razorflank's medallion lies deep within Razorfen Kraul, carried by the crone who rules the stronghold. Its return gives the night elf sentinels proof that she has fallen.

sections.title: Proof of the Crone's Fall
sections.body: Charlga Razorflank carries the medallion as the leader of the Razorfen quilboar. At Thalanaar, Falfindel Waywarder learns of fallen explorers such as Heralath and the dwarf Lonebrow, then sends Alliance adventurers against the quilboar leader. The medallion confirms Charlga's death to the night elf sentinels guarding Feralas's borders. They can know that the gathered forces within the Kraul have lost their leader.

faq.answer: Charlga Razorflank carries the medallion deep within Razorfen Kraul. She is the crone who leads the quilboar there.

faq.q: Who wants this medallion brought to them?
faq.answer: Falfindel Waywarder at Thalanaar asks for the medallion. He wants proof that Charlga has been slain.

faq.q: Why does Falfindel need proof of Charlga's death?
faq.answer: Charlga gathered a hostile quilboar force within Razorfen Kraul, threatening the surrounding regions. Heralath and Lonebrow were among the scouts who died. The medallion assures the night elves that the immediate threat is broken and lets their investigations continue.

angles.text: As an Alliance adventurer, recovering the medallion avenges the fallen scout Heralath and the dwarf explorer Lonebrow. It secures Thalanaar's border route into Feralas.
As a night elf, slaying Charlga and claiming her medallion lets your people safely study Agamaggan's corrupted sacred resting grounds.
